diagnosis.primary: the loss excludes steps 0 through 15 even though their commands initialise the recurrent trajectory and steps 5 through 15 directly control the robot
diagnosis.secondary: student-generated previous commands and observations compound the initial recurrent-state error after the loss-bearing suffix begins
diagnosis.target_multimodality: not established as a primary failure; local neighbour variance is a short-history ambiguity proxy, while exact repeated full trajectories have deterministic targets
diagnosis.previous_action_semantics: the stored value is the previous requested policy command; during the five-step lock it is not the planar hold action applied by the environment

recommended_next_correction.first: train the same n=64, k=2 policy on the same frozen dataset with action loss on every valid step, including the locked and live prefix
recommended_next_correction.gate: evaluate the corrected seed on the 225 no-blackout validation shots before opening the blackout comparison
recommended_next_correction.only_if_needed: if prefix supervision does not recover credible no-blackout control, collect deterministic shadow-teacher labels on student rollouts to address the measured covariate shift
